examples.en: Who's cooking tonight?
I'm making coffee, do you want some too?

tips: In slang «кувати» also means to cook up, to scheme. The basic meaning is to cook food or to boil.
It covers both "to cook" and "to boil": кувати ручак, кувати јаја, кувати кафу.
Знам да кувам - I can cook; кувам на свадбама - I cook at weddings (as a chef). For a specific dish use спремати: «Шта спремаш?», «спремам рибу».

examples.en: The police arrested the terrorist.
The terrorists claimed responsibility for the attack.
What is your date of birth?
He has lived in Niš since birth.
You owe me an apology.
I accept your apology.

forms: закунем се, закуну се; impf. заклињати се

examples.en: Swear that you won't tell anyone.

examples.sr: [Заклѐо] се да више никад неће лагати.
examples.en: He swore that he would never lie again.
How big is your new apartment?
I didn't know how big that house was.
It's hard to maintain a big house.

examples.sr: Фестивал се [одржа̀ва] сваке године у јулу.
examples.en: The festival is held every year in July.
They live in the vicinity of Belgrade.

examples.sr: Дете се брзо навикло на нову [о̀колину].
examples.en: The child quickly got used to his new surroundings.
His disappearance is still a mystery.
She is a complete mystery to me.
She bought a fashion magazine.
The article was published in a scientific journal.
A fight broke out in the tavern.
He was expelled from school for fighting.
This could take a while.
The meeting will last until noon.
She was wearing a yellow dress.
In October the leaves are already yellow.
The meeting is on Thursday.
We play soccer every Thursday.

examples.sr: Синоћ је била [пу̀цњава] у центру града.
examples.en: There was a shootout in the city center last night.
We heard gunfire and ran away.
Don't give our secret away to anyone!
We paid tribute to the fallen soldiers.
The scientists carried out an interesting experiment.
We'll give it a try, it'll be a small experiment.
How much do you earn a month?
He earns a living playing music on the street.
She was delighted with the gift.
I'm not really thrilled about that idea.

examples.sr: Провели смо викенд у [ко̀либи] на планини.
examples.en: We spent the weekend in a cabin in the mountains.
He lived in a small wooden hut.
He's being treated at a private clinic.

examples.sr: Ради као лекар на [клѝници] за децу.
examples.en: She works as a doctor at a children's clinic.

examples.sr: Да ли си се [тѐстирао] на вирус?

examples.sr: Следеће недеље се [сѐлимо] у нови стан.
examples.en: Next week we're moving into a new apartment.

examples.sr: Птице се у јесен [се̏ле̄] на југ.
examples.en: In the fall the birds migrate south.
This was done superbly.
I feel great!
The army entered the city.
She has a whole army of admirers.
A button came off my shirt.
Press the red button.
This is a new version of the program.
We also heard his version of the story.

examples.sr: Деца не смеју да пливају без [на̀дзора].
examples.en: Children are not allowed to swim without supervision.
The suspect is under police surveillance.
The city is in mourning because of the tragedy.

examples.sr: Са [жа̏лошћу] вас обавештавамо да је преминуо.
examples.en: With sorrow we inform you that he has passed away.

tips: «Раскинути уговор» - to terminate a contract («раскинути везу» - to break up with a partner).

forms: избегнем, избегну; past избегао; impf. избегавати

examples.en: We narrowly avoided an accident.

examples.sr: Ако желиш да [избѐгнеш] гужву, крени рано.
examples.en: If you want to avoid the crowds, set off early.

Put your wallet in the inside pocket.

The soldier is seriously wounded.
The wounded were taken to the hospital.
Fasten your seat belts, we're taking off.
He has a black belt in karate.
Basically, he's right.
That's the heart of the problem.

meanings: «криво ми је» I feel bad, I'm sorry

examples.en: The picture is hanging crooked.
I'm sorry you didn't come.

note: «криво ми је» - I feel bad, I'm upset

examples.en: Children have a rich imagination.
It's just a figment of your imagination.

tips: The noun «машта» means imagination, fantasy («богата машта»), not a dream in the sense of an ambition. That sense is «сан», and "to dream" is сањати or маштати.

examples.en: Take a step back.

examples.sr: Бројао је [у̀наза̄д] од десет до нуле.
examples.en: He counted backward from ten to zero.

I have tons of work today.
The police searched the apartment.

This year the winter was mild.

examples.sr: Њен деда је [бла̑г] и стрпљив човек.
examples.en: Her grandfather is a kind and patient man.
He hit his head and lost consciousness.
He hasn't regained consciousness yet.
Your nose is bleeding!
The wound is still bleeding.
Grandpa walks with a cane.

examples.sr: Узми [шта̑п] за пецање, идемо на реку.
examples.en: Get the fishing rod, we're going to the river.

Our fridge is completely empty.
You're a total jerk!

examples.sr: Како је [реа̀говао] кад је чуо вест?

The café has a pleasant atmosphere.

There is a time limit of one hour.
He looked me straight in the eye.
Lay the paper flat on the table.

Who committed this crime?
The phone's battery has died.
I need a new battery for the remote.
What time do you close?
Don't close the window, it's hot.

Do you want a little more soup?

note: супа - thin soup; a thick one is чорба

examples.en: This dish is a perfect combination of flavors.

examples.sr: Лош [спо̑ј] у жицама изазвао је пожар.
examples.en: A bad connection in the wiring caused a fire.

examples.sr: Њен брат је прави [џи̏н], висок је два метра.
examples.en: Her brother is a real giant, he's two meters tall.

What's the trick with that?

examples.sr: Не љути се, то је била само [фо̏ра].
examples.en: Don't be angry, it was just a joke.

tips: Meanings: a head start in time («имамо две недеље форе»), the catch or fun of something («у чему је фора?»), a trick («провалио сам ти фору»), a way of doing something («постоји ли нека фора?»).
A reaction to a joke or a clever idea: «Баш је фора!» - what a good joke, how cool.
A trick, a catch, a way: Која ти је то фора? Провалио сам фору - I saw through the trick. Имамо две недеље форе - we have a two-week head start.

examples.sr: Урадио је [су̀протно] од онога што сам тражио.
examples.en: He did the opposite of what I asked.
Contrary to expectations, we won.
The media reported the news.

examples.sr: Не верујем свему што пише у [ме̑дијима].
examples.en: I don't believe everything that's written in the media.
We have a pet, a cat.
Put on your house slippers.
This lake is very deep.
He fell into a deep sleep.
Tell us a joke!

The whole nation watched the match.
People of various nationalities live there.

examples.sr: [Па̏мтим] тај дан као да је било јуче.
examples.en: I remember that day as if it were yesterday.

tips: «Памтити» means to keep in memory, to retain (памтим твој број), while «сећати се» means to recall, to bring back from memory (сећам се нашег разговора).

examples.en: For lunch we're having chicken with vegetables.

tips: The bird is «кокошка», the meat is «пилетина».

examples.en: This tie is choking me.

tips: «Презиме» is the surname. «Фамилија» means the family: «моја фамилија» is my family, not my surname.

examples.en: Don't be a fool!

She cried with joy.

I'm getting off at the next stop.
Grandma is slowly going down the stairs.

The enemy fleet is approaching the shore.
The company has a fleet of twenty trucks.

examples.sr: [Тру̏пе] су ушле у град у зору.
examples.en: The troops entered the city at dawn.

related.en: to burn, to set on fire

examples.sr: [Увѐравам] вас да је све у реду.

examples.en: My dad works in Germany.

tips: «Ћале» and «кева» are the affectionate colloquial "dad" and "mom": «ћале ме вози на посао». Friends use them instead of the formal отац and мајка.

examples.en: Use reason, not emotions.

I'm begging you, don't go!

It will rain over the next few days.

examples.sr: Сада смо и [зва̀нично] муж и жена.
examples.en: Now we're officially husband and wife.

tips: «Башта ресторана» - a restaurant's outdoor terrace, «стаклена башта» - greenhouse, «ботаничка башта» - botanical garden, «ефекат стаклене баште» - greenhouse effect.

A flag is flying over the building.

You're a total liar!

You've made great progress!
Technological progress is getting faster.
I have to get rid of old things.

We play soccer every Saturday.
My husband is crazy about soccer.

tips: The main rivalry in Serbian soccer is the match between «Црвена звезда» and «Партизан», the Belgrade derby with a fiery atmosphere.

examples.en: You've finally arrived!

tips: Usually after a number of times: једном недељно, два пута недељно, један третман недељно. Likewise дневно (daily), месечно (monthly), годишње (yearly).

examples.en: Don't turn around, someone is following us.

tips: Both weight (тежина пртљага) and heaviness, difficulty (тежина задатка).

note: the person goes in the dative: затребаће ми - I will need it

examples.en: I'm the deputy director.

note: in speech usually a cigarette; a cigar is also «пура»

examples.en: He hurt his leg in a fall.

tips: Both «ормар» and «орман» occur; «ормар» is considered more standard, «орман» is often heard in speech.

note: заинтересован за + acc.: за посао - interested in the job

examples.en: He held a coin in his palm.

note: рука - hand and arm, шака - only the hand

examples.en: Smoking ruins your health.
